plainText:
Lindsay Sheppard is a voice actress for the English-language dub of and Pokémon Masters EX. She is currently affiliated with The Sheppard Agency.

==Biography==
Sheppard was born on Long Island, New York. She went to college to study animation and was first introduced to voiceovers in 2001 when she performed voices for student projects. Her first role was as Jimi in The Adventures of Shanmao & Jimi. From there, she pursued voiceover work in commercials, narration, and video games. She then joined the during and initially voiced , the reigning , but she was eventually replaced by Eileen Stevens after moving to Austin, Texas. She would later return in Pokémon Masters EX to voice .
